scope: Host CPU; Homey I/O and time simulated. Not a real Homey CPU reading.

report.attribution: Per-input requests cover the synchronous handler only. Async continuations and timers are not attributed. Requests may be coalesced; they are not evaluations.
report.frequencyMethod: One-second buckets aligned to session start. Large or structured payloads are not deeply compared.
